contractCases.expected: Select is a direct alias of SelectPrimitive.Root, not a native select wrapper. Generic value/defaultValue and onValueChange distinguish single Value|null from multiple arrays. open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange/onOpenChangeComplete are independent of selected value; default modal=true. Root name/form/required/autoComplete use its hidden form control; object labels/form values use itemToStringLabel/itemToStringValue and comparison uses isItemEqualToValue. SelectValue resolves labels from Root items or registered ItemText; it is not a label for the field. Trigger defaults native button role=combobox with size sm|default. Content defaults bottom/center, offsets4/0 and alignItemWithTrigger=true; it inserts scroll arrows and List automatically. Items are role=option; disabled entries can be focused but cannot commit, while closed typeahead skips disabled choices. Single commit requests closing separately, even if the value callback is canceled; multiple toggles array values and normally stays open. readOnly locks changes but deliberately allows opening/browsing. GroupLabel/Separator are actual primitive parts; no text-query input, filter, server fetch or custom command event is invented.

Trigger Enter/Space/opening arrows operate the source popup. Open Up/Down/Home/End and label typeahead move highlight; Enter/Space choose an enabled option. Closed-trigger typeahead can commit a single value, but is disabled for readOnly or multiple. Escape dismisses without selecting a highlighted candidate; controlled open/value callbacks remain separately authoritative. Disabled Root suppresses interaction. Named visible label and error/help relations belong to the caller, not the placeholder.
Each applicable actual callback preserves its own authority; canceling value need not cancel independent popup closing.
